api: An explicitly named Formly or Angular API, configuration property, method or class. Extract the entire exact code path including brackets and quoted property segments. Include explicit type and key property names in configuration syntax. Exclude the library name Formly and ordinary nouns such as field, model or custom type. Extract a named API even if the question asks whether it exists.
custom_identifier: An explicitly supplied registration name for a field type or wrapper, or a supplied model key value. Extract the name itself without surrounding quotation marks. Exclude built-in API property paths and application component, screen, file or service names. Do not infer a registration name from a field's business purpose.
literal: An explicitly supplied configuration value or requested literal text: quoted strings, numeric values and boolean values. Include surrounding quotation marks for quoted values; retain exact spelling for numbers and booleans. Include supplied registration names and model key values as literals as well as custom identifiers. Exclude version numbers and quoted narrative claims about behavior.
version: An explicitly mentioned Formly or Angular version token, including a leading v when present. Extract only the exact version token, without the library name. Include version mentions in comparisons, corrections and exclusions.
ui_adapter: The explicitly named Formly UI library or adapter, such as Material, Bootstrap or PrimeNG. Extract only the exact adapter name. Include excluded or negated adapter mentions. Exclude generic phrases UI adapter, core and none.
